name: Adaptable Predators
summary: This unit is eligible to shoot and to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

name: Adaptive Instincts
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, choose one until the end of the phase: this unit's attacks can re-roll a Hit roll of 1, or its saving throws can re-roll a roll of 1.

name: Adaptive Instincts (Once per turn, per unit)
summary: When this unit is selected to fight, or is targeted by an enemy, choose one: its melee attacks get +1 Strength, or it gets +1 Toughness.

name: Aggressive Leader-beast
summary: In your opponent's Shooting phase, if a model in this unit was destroyed by an enemy unit's attacks, this unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

name: Alpha Leader
summary: While this model leads a unit, attacks made by models in it can have their Hit roll re-rolled.

name: Apex-beast
summary: Each attack this model makes against a Battle-shocked unit gains +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Bio-minefield
summary: Enemy units cannot start or end an Advance move within 6" of this unit.

name: Bio-stimulus
summary: After this model shoots, select one hit enemy unit (once per turn): until the end of the turn, friendly Tyranids melee attacks against it have their Armour Penetration improved by 1.

name: Blistering Assault
summary: In your opponent's Shooting phase, if a model in this unit lost a wound from an enemy unit's attacks, this unit can make a surge move of up to D6+2".

name: Bounding Leap
summary: This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Brood Progenitor (Aura, Psychic)
summary: While a friendly Termagants unit is within 6" of this model, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the Lethal Hits ability.

name: Burning Spray
summary: After this unit shoots, select one hit enemy unit: until the end of the phase, it cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

name: Chitinous Horrors
summary: While an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of a unit with this ability, that enemy unit's Objective Control characteristic is halved.

name: Chitinous Horrors (Aura)
summary: While an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of this unit, that enemy unit's Objective Control characteristic is halved.

name: Death Scream
summary: After this model shoots, select one hit unit: it must take a Battle-shock test with -1 applied.

name: Defensive Stance
summary: When this unit is targeted with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, it scores hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+, or 4+ instead while it is within range of an objective marker.

name: Digestion Spine
summary: Each time this model fights, if its attacks destroy one or more non-Vehicle enemy models, it regains up to D3 lost wounds.

name: Disruption Bombardment
summary: After this unit shoots, select one hit enemy Infantry unit: until the end of the opponent's next turn, it has -2 to its Move characteristic and -2 to Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

name: Domination of the Hive Mind (Aura)
summary: While a friendly Tyranids unit is within 9" of this model, it counts as being within your army's Synapse Range.

name: Encephalic Diffusion (Aura, Psychic)
summary: While an enemy unit is within 6" of this model, its attacks suffer -1 to the Hit roll, and also -1 to the Wound roll if that unit is Below Half-strength.

name: Enhanced Toxic Miasma
summary: While this model leads a unit, the range of that unit's Foul Spores Aura ability increases to 9".

name: Feeding Frenzy
summary: Each melee attack this model makes against a unit below its Starting Strength gains +1 to the Hit roll, and also +1 to the Wound roll if that unit is Below Half-strength.

name: Floating Death
summary: Each time this unit or an enemy unit ends a move, each model in this unit within 3" of an enemy picks one of those enemy units and is destroyed; roll a D6 for it, inflicting mortal wounds on a scale that varies by datasheet.

name: Foul Spores (Aura)
summary: Friendly TYRANIDS units within 6" of this unit have the Stealth ability.

name: Frenzied Metabolism
summary: When this model shoots, you may add 1 to the Wound roll of its attacks until the end of the phase; if you do, afterward roll a D6, and on a 2+ this model suffers D3 mortal wounds.

name: Grasping Tendrils
summary: Each time a non-Titanic enemy unit within Engagement Range of a unit with this ability is selected to Fall Back, roll a D6: on a 3+ it must Remain Stationary instead.

name: Grisly Spectacle
summary: Each time this model fights, if its attacks destroy an enemy unit, every enemy unit within 6" of it must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Guardian Organism
summary: While a Character model leads this unit, that Character has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

name: Harpoon Barbs
summary: Once per turn, when an enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model is selected to Fall Back, roll a D6: on a 2+ it suffers D6 mortal wounds.

name: Harpooned
summary: After the bearer shoots with this weapon, select one hit enemy Monster or Vehicle unit: until the end of the turn, Charge rolls made to charge that unit are increased by 2.

name: Hive Commander
summary: At the start of your Command phase, if this model is on the battlefield, you gain 1CP.

name: Hive Defences
summary: This model can be targeted with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP, even if a different unit was already targeted this turn, but only once per turn.

name: Hypertoxic Miasma (Aura)
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, roll a D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of this model: on 2-3 it suffers 1 mortal wound, on 4-5 D3 mortal wounds, on a 6 D6 mortal wounds.

name: Hypnotic Gaze (Psychic)
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model: until the end of the phase, its attacks suffer -1 to the Hit roll.

name: Irresistible Force
summary: This model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

name: Malign Presence (Aura)
summary: If this model is your Warlord, each time the opponent targets a unit within 12" of it with a Stratagem, that Stratagem's cost increases by 1CP.

name: Neurocytes
summary: While this unit is within Synapse Range of a friendly non-Neurogaunt Tyranids unit, it has the Synapse keyword.

name: Neuroloids
summary: In your Command phase, select up to two friendly Tyranids units within 18" of this model's unit: until your next Command phase, they always count as within your army's Synapse Range.

name: Node Lash (Psychic)
summary: While this model leads a unit, its attacks gain +1 to the Hit roll, and also +1 to the Wound roll if the target is Battle-shocked.

name: Onslaught (Aura, Psychic)
summary: While a friendly Tyranids unit is within 6" of this model, ranged weapons equipped by models in it have the Assault and Lethal Hits abilities.

name: Overgrown Barbs
summary: After this model shoots, select one hit non-Titanic enemy unit: until your next turn, while this model remains on the battlefield, that unit's attacks suffer -1 to their Hit roll.

name: Prey Adaptation
summary: Each time this model's unit is selected to fight, choose one of Sustained Hits 1, Lance, or Lethal Hits for its melee weapons until the end of the phase.

name: Psychic Terror (Psychic)
summary: If a model with this ability is on the battlefield when you unleash Shadow in the Warp, subtract 1 from the resulting Battle-shock tests enemy units must take.

name: Resilient Organism
summary: Once per battle, when an attack is allocated to this model, its Damage characteristic can be changed to 0.

name: Seed Mucolids
summary: Once per turn, instead of shooting, this unit can add a new 1-model MUCOLID SPORES unit to your army, set up wholly within 18" of this model and more than 8" from all enemy units.

name: Seed Spore Mines
summary: Once per turn, instead of shooting, this unit can add a new SPORE MINES unit (1 model per model in this unit) to your army, set up wholly within 48" of this unit and more than 8" from all enemy units.

name: Serpentine Fiend
summary: This model can move through terrain features (but not end its move inside one) and can be set up or end a move on any floor level of Ruins, provided its base does not overhang a non-ground floor.

name: Singular Purpose
summary: At the start of the first battle round, choose for the rest of the battle: attacks vs a chosen enemy unit re-roll Hit and Wound rolls, or while in range of a chosen objective this model gains Feel No Pain 5+ and OC 15.

name: Skulking Horrors
summary: In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit and it is not in Engagement Range, it can make a Normal move of up to D6".

name: Spawn Termagants
summary: In your Command phase, select one friendly Termagants unit within 6" of this model (once per unit per phase): return up to D3+3 destroyed models to it.

name: Spirit Leech (Aura, Psychic)
summary: While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit and it contains a Neurothrope, each time that enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test it suffers D3 mortal wounds and a model in this unit regains up to D3 lost wounds.

name: Spore Mine Cysts
summary: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase: target one visible enemy unit (not Lone Operative) within 24" and roll six D6 (1 mortal wound per 3+), or add a D3-model SPORE MINES unit within 6" and 8"+ from enemies; only one model per turn.

name: Stalking Forward
summary: Each time this model makes a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move, it can move through non-Titanic models and terrain features that are 4" or less in height as if they were not there.

name: Subterranean Hunter
summary: At the end of the Fight phase, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit, it can be removed from the battlefield and placed into Strategic Reserves.

name: Swallow Whole
summary: Each attack with this model's gaping maw against an Infantry, Mounted, or Beasts unit scores a Critical Wound on any successful unmodified Wound roll, and this model regains up to D3+2 lost wounds each time such a model is destroyed by it.

name: Symbiotic Targeting
summary: After this model shoots, select one hit enemy unit: until the end of the phase, friendly Tyranids attacks against it can re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

name: Unnatural Resilience
summary: This model has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

name: Unstoppable Monster
summary: At the start of each player's Command phase, this model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

name: Vanguard Predator
summary: Each attack a model in this unit makes can re-roll a Hit roll of 1, and also a Wound roll of 1 if the target is within range of an objective marker.

name: Vicious Insight
summary: While this model leads a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the Devastating Wounds ability.

name: Warp Field (Aura, Psychic)
summary: While a friendly Tyranids unit is within 6" of this unit, models in it have a 6+ invulnerable save.
